description: Live-model ingestion evaluation fixtures (phase-2 eval harness). Each case is synthetic TXT whose expected claims are verbatim substrings of the evidence text - the harness measures claim recall, extraction precision, field validation rate, unsupported-claim rate and (gated) locator accuracy by re-verifying every artifact against its cited source record in the database. Multi-paragraph cases make locator accuracy meaningful (one record per paragraph).
